summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Class A Regular Director Manuel Adorni for strictly personal reasons, accepted by the Board on July 8, 2026. No terms, consideration, premium, or advisor are stated. The filing is a straightforward disclosure of a board departure, not tied to any broader special situation. As a foreign private issuer's current report, this maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 for director resignation. Watch for any subsequent filings that may indicate director replacements or broader governance shifts, but this is isolated and ordinary.
